correctionOfRevision2: Revision 2 described the changes of commit 94038e2b but bound its commit field to the earlier 85146176. The field named the state I had measured before writing, not the state the description belongs to.

countDifferenceResolved.statement: Neither number was wrong; one of them was reported without the selector that produced it.
countDifferenceResolved.difference: 31 cases, and they are the courier subscription and message data fixtures the union adds. Both runs reproduce today on the same tree.
countDifferenceResolved.canonicalScope: The serializer scope is the lead selector, FullyQualifiedName~Serialization. The union was a working selection while re-pointing fixtures and is not a scope definition.
countDifferenceResolved.lesson: A count without its selector is not a measurement. Every number in a future report carries the argument array that produced it.
